description: China A-share restricted-share unlock calendar (限售股解禁): which stocks have locked-up shares becoming tradable on a given day or date range, ranked by unlock market value or by share of float. Answers "today's unlock list", "解禁日历", "限售股解禁 2026-11-06 top 10 by market value", "how many stocks unlock next week", "when does 603376 unlock", "解禁市值排名". Each unlock has the stock, unlock date, restricted-share type (e.g. first-day original-holder shares, IPO strategic placement, private-placement shares), shares unlocking, market value at the latest price in CNY, percent of total shares and percent of the pre-unlock tradable float, number of holder batches, and the stock's price change over the 20 trading days before and after. Also returns the per-day total: number of unlocking stocks and their combined market value. Give `date`, or `from` and `to` (max 31 days), or neither for today; `symbol` (6-digit code) lists that stock's unlock dates. Source: Eastmoney datacenter, restricted-share unlock report (keyless).

date.description: Single unlock day, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD (default: today).

from.description: Range start (YYYY-MM-DD); use with `to`. Max span 31 days.

limit.description: Max unlock rows returned, 1-100 (default 20). Per-day totals always cover every unlock fetched.

sort.description: Rank by unlock market value (default) or by percent of pre-unlock tradable float.

symbol.description: 6-digit A-share code (e.g. "603376"): list only that stock's unlocks (default window: 1 year back to 1 year ahead if no date given).

name: ashares_unlock_calendar
title: Ashares Unlock Calendar
